name: 248-encap-recursive
description: Issue 248 recursion. Parent encapsulates the outer sub-map; the outer sub-map itself encapsulates the inner sub-map. After the load-time inline pass iterates twice, the flat graph reaches three writers: the inner sub-map's externally-consumed write box, the outer sub-map's externally-consumed write box, and the parent-side write box. All three should land identical bytes on disk, proving that input-side and output-side splices both compose across nesting.
